ask: Is the USB cable power+data or charge-only? Try another cable.
Measure 5V rail to GND with multimeter — what do you read?
Are the breadboard red/blue rails split in the middle?
causes: regulator in dropout (9V battery dead / barrel <7V)

symptom: MCU resets when motor / WiFi / servo activates
ask: Does it reset only under load?
What powers the load — same 5V pin as MCU?
How long/thin is the USB cable?
causes: missing bulk capacitor (add 470-1000µF at driver input)
fix: Separate supply for load, common GND, short thick USB, bulk cap.

ask: Is that the Arduino's built-in LED, or an external LED on a breadboard?
Which board and pin is it on, and what is the supply voltage?
Long leg toward + through a resistor — what value?
causes: onboard LED never driven (pin still INPUT or wrong sketch — test with Blink)
missing/wrong resistor (needs Vs, Vf and current before computing)
open jumper or split breadboard rail

ask: INPUT or INPUT_PULLUP?
Is there a 10k pull-up/down?
Long unshielded wire near motors?
fix: Use INPUT_PULLUP or 10k resistor, shorten wires, common GND.

ask: Anything on GPIO0/2/12/15? Disconnect and reboot.
Holding BOOT button during flash?
Serial baud 115200 — what does the panic say?
causes: strapping pin held wrong at boot
ADC2 + WiFi conflict / watchdog from blocking loop

symptom: DHT / ultrasonic / I2C garbage or NaN
ask: Common GND? Pull-up present? Cable length?
I2C scan — does the address appear?
DHT: 2s between reads?
causes: wrong address / bus speed too high

ask: Can you ping the broker IP from a laptop on the same WiFi?
Same subnet? Guest/AP isolation?
Topic string exact incl. slashes/case?
Servo on separate 5V 2A supply with common GND?
50Hz signal pin only from MCU?
fix: Separate 5V supply, common GND, correct 50Hz servo pulses.
